archive_storage: temporary RAM filesystem; copy to durable storage after free space is available

source_warning_independent_audit.scope: Direct Booster inference with independently applied calibration/support projection, feature warnings, truth-free matched-score ranking, per-group confusion counts and cluster bootstrap.
source_warning_independent_audit.limits: Same source cases, feature-design code and fixed model are reused; does not establish unseen climates, sensor accuracy, prospective threshold validity or an operational risk guarantee.

source_margin_independent_audit.scope: Independent feature-margin flags, deterministic score ranking, group totals and bootstrap summaries.
source_margin_independent_audit.limitations: Same observed features, frozen source extrema and model outputs are reused. Tolerances are posthoc and do not establish error calibration, prospective release or independent climates.

restricted_model_environment.environment: Existing isolated Python environment with user site disabled; source-case table and model were supplied from restricted local paths.
restricted_model_environment.limitations: The same fitted model, source cases and feature-design code are reused. This does not resolve source data rights, establish independent climates or reproduce training from raw observations.

limitations: The source-warning audits explicitly use local restricted source cases and fixed model; those inputs are not in the candidate ZIP. Neither the source evaluation nor group bootstrap establishes independent-climate validity, quality, calibrated risk or a prospective policy.
